endpoint: Source clinical AD versus CN; neither severity staging nor diagnosis of MCI

initialization.source: Official torchvision MobileNetV3-Large ImageNet1K V1 only

train_loss: unweighted patient cross entropy on mean slice logits

selection.rule: Save checkpoint only if full clean Besga validation patient NLL improves by more than min_delta

learning_rate: Cosine decay over fixed100epochs to5percent of initial rates
trainable_features: Only feature blocks14,15,16 after5head-only epochs; all other feature parameters frozen
batchnorm: All running statistics and affine parameters frozen throughout
eval_transform: Existing frozen224x224RGB pixels /255 then ImageNet mean/std; no geometry or augmentation

evaluation.primary_model: Fixed equal-probability ensemble of all3 independently validation-selected seeds
evaluation.representative: lowest validation NLL, then ascending seed; attribution only
evaluation.mci: 10Harvard MCI remain outsidebinary metrics; report separately without relabeling
evaluation.reused_sources: Besga test11 and OpenNeuro prior external are descriptive reused cohorts
evaluation.old_comparators: All3fixedmultitaskclinicalheads with historical mean-probability pooling, plus equal-probability ensemble; whole-pipelinecomparison

spending_authority: User machine cap10USD/hour; no total cap; resource control belongs to root
limitations: Only19freshAD/CNT1patients, with broad uncertainty and case-control spectrum bias
No validated brain segmentation, atlas registration, prospective workflow or calibrated clinical-risk claim
Besga/OpenNeuro outcomes previously inspected; fresh external cohort must remain unused until model/selection freeze
Different scanner/site/population and preprocessing may impair transportability; no superiority promise
